# Companion and intended use

**Student unit:** [Exact filename, title and section identifiers.]

This companion contains teaching notes and exercise solutions. The student
unit is the document to discuss in class and leave with students after the
lesson. It contains the explanations and worked examples needed for
independent review; it does not require this companion to render.

Keep this file separate from the student handout. Files committed to the
public course repository, including files on branches, are accessible.
Only upload filled-in solutions when their release is intended. If you later
distribute solutions to students, prepare a solutions-only copy without the
teaching notes.
